title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30336: add OnValidateNoOnBeforeModifyCapNeedEntries event in Prod. Order Routing Line
summary: Production Order Routing Line table adds an integration event OnValidateNoOnBeforeModifyCapNeedEntries that fires after work/machine center transfer logic but before capacity needs are updated, giving extensions access to both current and previous record state.
key_points: New event raises in field No. OnValidate trigger after WorkCenterTransferFields/MachineCtrTransferFields
Provides both Rec and xRec to compare routing line changes at a specific execution point
Allows customizations to run validation logic without duplicating standard behavior
Event added in both base and IT layer implementations
